en: Dependent on a wholesome state of the formless sphere (*arūpāvacara*), a non-form-sphere non-wholesome state arises by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*).
Dependent on a non-form-sphere wholesome state, a non-form-sphere non-wholesome state arises by way of root condition.
There are two [answers] for root; ... pe ... there are two for non-disappearance (*avigata*).

Dependent on a non-material unwholesome state, there arises a non-material non-unwholesome state by way of root condition. There is one [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance. (The indeterminate root has two conditions.)
